rounding_scope_proof: For neighboring integer roots n,n+1, the exact root-midpoint radicand is n^2+n+1/4, whereas nearest-square comparison switches at n^2+n+1/2. Both lie strictly between the same consecutive integers, so every integer radicand gives the same decision. This does not extend to all decimal radicands. The lesson states both the integer restriction and the general squared-midpoint boundary.
